status: Historical candidate evaluation, subsequently owner-approved and integrated into local Milestone 6. See AI_REPLY_INTEGRATION_RESULTS.json.
method: Eight explicit paid calls across four synthetic cases. Focused Jonah repeats removed year-confirmation wording and irrelevant staff notes; the latter came from listing absent amenities in the context. Offsite was repeated after manual review caught implied capacity confirmation. Jonah uses the final positive-only facts block; the other retained outputs precede that last context-only change. No automatic retries or full regression suite.
limitations: Small synthetic sample, not a general reliability claim.
Some model drafts repeat amenity wording or add an unnecessary closing invitation. Staff editing remains necessary; the final Jonah notes no longer ask for unrelated facilities.
Integration now aligns the date validator with the current-year policy; exact quote/booking validation remains separate.
Existing quote/booking validation stays separate; no prices, stock holds or bookings were generated.
